CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

   B. Say : 1Peter Selected teachings has no place in daily life.
   C. Use : 1Peter Selected teachings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
